fields.System.Title: INB-205 — Record an over-receipt within tolerance
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want small over-deliveries accepted automatically, so that a
truck is not held up over two extra units.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a quantity above expected but within the configured tolerance, then it is
  • accepted without approval.
  • - Given the acceptance, then a discrepancy record is still created — accepted is not the
  • same as unrecorded.
  • - Given the tolerance is configured as a percentage and an absolute cap, then the
  • stricter of the two applies.
  • - Given the tolerance check, then it is enforced in the service layer, so it cannot be
  • bypassed by a different client.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, platform |
| Tables | receipt_line, discrepancy, config |
| Risks | Tolerance applied inconsistently between API and UI ([doc 04 §3.4](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
